Each port has one bar lamp under it, centred on the cage (the render reads 0.1-0.4 mm right, about 1-2 px). Every legend sits LEFT of its lamp except 2/1 and 2/2, which the face prints to the RIGHT of theirs, with \"LNK/ACT\" left of the 2/1 lamp - drawn as printed. The ordering table's \"4x10G SFP+ for uplink, 12x1G SFP for downlink\" makes 1/1-1/4 the SFP+ uplinks."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"\"Dual redundant power supplies\", \"100-240V AC, 48-60V DC\"; ordered with one AC (XM-3352-AC-NA) or DC (XM-3352-DC) supply, two of either (-2AC-NA, -2DC), or one of each (XM-3352-AC/DC, as the render shows it: AC above, DC below).
